security.title: Security & Anti-Fraud Center
security.subtitle: Protect yourself from fake insurance certificates.
security.whyDesc: Fraudsters may create fake verification portals mimicking the ASAC interface to trick you into believing an invalid certificate is authentic. Always follow these 4 security safeguards to establish the source of truth.

rules.urlDesc: The official verification portal is located at https://vattestation.cm (https://vattestation.asac-cameroun.org also redirects to it). Make sure the address bar in your browser matches our official domains.
rules.watermarkDesc: The official ASAC logo is embedded securely in the background of valid attestation displays.
rules.logoDesc: Official logos of insurance company members are loaded dynamically from our secure databases. Beware of generic or broken images.
rules.smsDesc: Any SMS results dispatched from our systems must strictly arrive under the 'ASAC' alphanumeric sender ID. If it is sent by a standard mobile number, it is fraudulent!
rules.whatsappDesc: Authenticate certificates directly with our official ASAC WhatsApp ChatBot. User-initiated conversations are 100% free and protected against fraudulent systems.

help.title: Help & Instructions
help.subtitle: Everything you need to know to verify a motor insurance certificate in Cameroon.
help.statusIntro: Only the "Valid" status means the vehicle is covered today.
help.howTitle: How to verify an insurance certificate?

steps.title: Scan the QR code
steps.desc: Open the "Scan QR Code" tab and hold the QR code printed on the digital certificate in front of your phone camera.

steps.title: Or enter the licence plate
steps.desc: Type the vehicle licence plate (e.g. LT123AA) or its chassis number (VIN) in the "Entry" tab.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.desc: The result appears immediately: insurer, validity dates and coverage status. You can also receive it by SMS.

faq.question: How do I verify a motor insurance certificate in Cameroon?
faq.answer: Go to vattestation.cm, then scan the certificate's QR code or enter the vehicle's licence plate or chassis number. The certificate status is displayed instantly.

faq.question: Is certificate verification free?
faq.answer: Yes. Verification on V-Attestation is completely free. ASAC will never ask you for money to verify a certificate's authenticity.

faq.question: What do the displayed statuses mean?
faq.answer: Only a "Valid" certificate means the vehicle is covered. "Expired", "Suspended", "Cancelled", "Upcoming" or "Not found" mean the vehicle is not covered today.

faq.question: How can I spot a fake certificate or a fake verification site?
faq.answer: Always check that the address shown is vattestation.cm, that the official ASAC watermark appears on the result, and that SMS messages come from the "ASAC" sender. See our Security Center for more tips.

faq.question: I have a paper certificate, can I get a digital one?
faq.answer: Yes. You can start the free conversion of your paper certificate into a secure digital certificate with a QR code at the ASAC Transition desk, with your paper certificate, vehicle registration card and ID card.

faq.question: Can I verify a certificate via WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Yes. ASAC's official WhatsApp ChatBot lets you verify a certificate for free by simply sending the vehicle licence plate.
